_comment: D-08 factory-versioned dependency provenance policy. The dependency-gate CI check (docs/target-plumbing/dependency-gate.mjs) reads THIS factory-vendored copy, never a PR's own tree. allowedLicenses is the SPDX allowlist; minAgeDays/minWeeklyDownloads are provenance floors; maxNameDistance is the Levenshtein typosquat threshold against popularPackages. The popularPackages seed covers this factory's own stack plus common Node ecosystem names as the typosquat-distance reference set. This list grows ONLY via a reviewed factory PR — never a target-side edit.
